purpose: General workspace memory and agent configuration channel

key_decisions.decision: Memory architecture simplified to 3 layers: MEMORY.md (curated), JSONL stores (truth-repo, calibration), daily logs. Dropped memory-plex fragmentation.
key_decisions.outcome: Skills own their stores; truth-repo and calibration maintain their own JSONL files

key_decisions.decision: Deployment rule: root index.html bootstraps projects from subfolders. Projects stay in projects/<name>/. One index at root, never moved.
key_decisions.outcome: Add project → add link to root index

key_decisions.decision: Scripts go in scripts/, reports go in reports/, daily logs in memory/
Model context windows stored in USER.md and truth-repo
Conversation memory system: 14-day retention, 8hr silence triggers countdown, notify on expiration, distill to memory
key_decisions.outcome: Distilled conversations land in memory/conversations/ with topic/decisions/outcomes

key_decisions.decision: Discord bot requires Read Message History permission for past message access
key_decisions.outcome: Bot can read channel history now (verified 2026-05-08)

outcomes: Security scanner working with 33 pattern tests
Conversation memory system designed and now being implemented
insights: Pattern matching > name matching for secret detection
Separate stores cause sync drift — consolidate
HIGH confidence without outcome tracking loses meaning
